title: Production Edge Function protected-access verification
summary: Production probes confirm that every reviewed administrative function denies unauthorised calls, both pharmacy authentication functions reject untrusted origins, and a fresh management inventory confirms all reviewed deployments remain active at the governed versions.

checks.name: Administrative function denial
checks.detail: Cleanup, geocoding, pharmacy-contact review, and product-review calls without their protected credentials returned HTTP 403.

checks.name: Untrusted-origin denial
checks.detail: Both pharmacy authentication endpoints returned HTTP 403 for an untrusted origin and emitted no allow-origin header.

checks.name: Fresh six-function protected probe
checks.detail: A fresh production probe returned HTTP 403 for all four administrative endpoints without protected credentials and for both pharmacy authentication endpoints with an untrusted origin; none emitted an allow-origin header.

checks.name: Protected cleanup execution
checks.detail: The protected scheduled cleanup path executed after deployment and recorded a successful, non-stale aggregate maintenance result.

checks.name: Current six-function protected probe
checks.detail: At the latest verification, all four administrative functions and both pharmacy authentication functions returned HTTP 403 without the required authority, and none emitted an allow-origin header.

checks.name: Retired diagnostic endpoint safely contained
checks.detail: An unauthenticated production request to active env-dump version 6 returned HTTP 401 at the Supabase gateway. A complete static review of the downloaded deployed source found zero reportable security findings and confirmed that authenticated execution can only return a constant non-cacheable HTTP 410 retirement response. Response-body SHA-256: 2fa2c84fed16d2ecfffc375515c8095ca6be18d8dabe1f54fd12142d23834634.

checks.name: Current reviewed deployment inventory
checks.detail: A fresh linked-project management inventory reports geocode-pharmacies version 6, cleanup-prescriptions version 4, both pharmacy authentication functions at version 9, review-pharmacy-contacts version 3 and review-marketplace-products version 5, all ACTIVE with the intended gateway settings.
